Meridianul pe care eleganța Vestului își: The meridian along which Western elegance finds its roots in the East.
Zece automobile în cinci perechi clasic–: Ten automobiles in five classic–contemporary pairs and three new The Hunter House collections, all in a single day.
conceptIntro: Hunter comes from Old English huntian, to pursue with a purpose. Meridian, from the Latin meridies, is the line that sets a common point between hemispheres. Together, they become the line of sight of a Western standard of taste, traced along the route between East and West - the one London, Paris and Vienna traced a century ago, with a local accent at every court that carried it.
conceptContinuation: That line never broke. The Hunter Meridian proposes an annual landmark, with a new theme and new pieces at every edition, where every guest who has already seen Ascot or Saint-Moritz, and every person of culture who recognizes a masterpiece, brings with them a piece of that same meridian.
Un meridian unește lumile și le conectea: A meridian unites worlds and connects them.
Zece automobile, cinci perechi, aceleași: Ten automobiles, five pairs, the same brands displayed face to face.
piesaPara1: A one-of-a-kind work of art, only 5 examples exist in the world, officially attested by Lamborghini, having its first public display in Romania. Long before supercars, Ferruccio Lamborghini built tractors - that's how it all began.
piesaPara2: Next to it stands the present, telling the other half of the same story: what grew, in sixty years, out of this tractor - the Old Money and New Rich phenomenon, two moments of the same history. Classicism can be financed, but it can't be bought, because it's a matter of time, not money. The tractor is there to remind us what actually sustains the value of the car beside it.
Ești interesat de mai multe detalii sau: Interested in more details or a partnership with The Hunter Meridian? Write to us and we'll get back to you as soon as possible.
row1Body: Ten exceptional automobiles, displayed in classic-contemporary pairs. Centerpiece: the Lamborghini Centenario Tractor.
row3Body: Three collections presented for the first time: hunting, equestrian, and feminine lifestyle.
